name: fleetcraft
description: Evidence-backed execution, verification, and model-routing controls for Claude Code.

delegation_mode.title: Delegation guard mode
delegation_mode.description: audit adds a reminder; strict asks for confirmation before publish-shaped commands. Only audit and strict are supported; invalid values fail closed at runtime.

autoload_judgment.title: Autoload judgment kernel
autoload_judgment.description: Inject Fleetcraft's compact, bundled judgment kernel at session start.

completion_gate.title: Completion evidence gate
completion_gate.description: When enabled, verified tasks require Evidence: and Validation: fields before closing.

evidence_batch.title: Batch evidence reminders
evidence_batch.description: When enabled, summarize each completed parallel tool batch for the next model request.
